integrity: Universal assertion supported by an explicit residue-slice proof. Exact integer verifier provided as corroboration. No independent audit, publication, or authorship claim.
scientific_limitations: Proves only the exponent pair 4 and q squared, where q is any odd prime. Finite enumerations test q=3,5,7,11,13 but are not a proof for all primes. An equivalent result in less accessible work cannot be excluded.
title: Exact divisor height \(B(4q^2)=4\) for every odd prime
